subject.title: fix(skills): refuse owner-qualified ClawHub force install over a different owner

question: Should owner-qualified `skills install --force` fail closed when the existing tracked skill has the same slug but a different owner?
rationale: The patch prevents silent installed-skill replacement and aligns install with update/verify owner checks, but it changes the current-main force-install behavior for any workflow that intentionally used cross-owner replacement.

options.title: Accept fail-closed owner guard
options.body: Merge the PR as the preferred data-integrity fix and accept that cross-owner forced replacement now requires a different explicit path.

options.title: Require explicit owner-transfer path
options.body: Ask for a deliberate override or transfer flow before merge if maintainers want cross-owner replacement to stay possible without silent clobbering.

options.title: Preserve current force behavior
options.body: Reject the guard and keep `--force` as an unconditional same-slug replacement even across owners, accepting the installed-state clobber risk.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed owner guard
recommendation.body: Merge the PR as the preferred data-integrity fix and accept that cross-owner forced replacement now requires a different explicit path.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a ClawHub behavior policy choice, and CONTRIBUTING.md lists this person as a ClawHub area owner.
